characters.name: Balaam
characters.description: Balaam, man about 60, thin and lanky with a long neck, pale olive skin, long scraggly grey beard he likes to scratch, bushy eyebrows over squinting eyes, a big hooked nose, long mustard-yellow robe with a purple striped cloak, tall pointed brown felt hat; carries a knobby wooden stick. Comic, grumpy but not scary.

characters.name: She-donkey
characters.description: Balaam's she-donkey, a gentle grey donkey with a pale belly and muzzle, very long ears with dark tips, big soft wise brown eyes with long lashes, a short dark mane, a red saddle cloth with yellow tassels and a simple leather bridle.

characters.name: Angel
characters.description: An angel: a tall gentle human figure made of soft white-golden light, in a plain flowing white robe, calm kind face, no wings and no halo, slightly translucent and glowing; raises one open hand in a calm 'stop' gesture, no sword.

characters.name: King Balak
characters.description: Balak, king of Moab, man about 50, short and round, olive skin, curly black beard, puffy cheeks, frowning eyebrows, rich purple robe with gold embroidery, a short gold crown, gold bracelets, red pointed slippers.

cover.prompt: Comic scene on a narrow path between stone walls of a vineyard: the grey she-donkey with her red saddle cloth has sat down in the middle of the path, ears up, looking calmly ahead at a tall glowing figure of soft white light with a raised open hand. Balaam, perched on her back, flails his arms in confusion, his pointed hat tilting. Warm afternoon light, medium-wide shot.

pages.prompt: Balaam rides out of a stone town at dawn on his grey she-donkey with the red saddle cloth, waving his stick forward with a self-important grin, his pointed hat bobbing. The donkey trots along patiently, long ears up. A winding road leads off into hills. Fresh morning light, cheerful wide shot.

Two scenes in one picture: on the left, in a grand hall, King Balak in purple and gold points dramatically into the distance, sending messengers bearing gifts; on the right, Balaam at night in his house rubs his hands greedily, then freezes as a soft warm light fills the window, the only sign of the divine voice. Comic, warm lamplight.

On a country road, the Angel, a tall figure of soft white light with a raised open hand, stands in the middle of the path. The she-donkey's eyes go wide and she swerves off into a green field of wheat. Balaam, who sees nothing, clings to her neck, his hat flying, shouting crossly. Bright day, wide shot, comic tone.

A narrow path between two low stone vineyard walls. The Angel of soft light stands ahead with an open raised hand. The she-donkey presses tightly against the wall, and Balaam's foot is squished against the stones; he grimaces comically, 'ouch' shown only by his funny face and a little puff of dust. Grapevines above. Midday light, medium shot.

A very narrow passage between rock walls with no room to turn. The she-donkey simply plops down on the ground, legs folded under her, calm and determined, a small puff of dust around her. Balaam, still on her back, waves his stick high in the air in a big angry tantrum, cheeks red. The Angel glows faintly ahead. Comic, warm light.

Close, funny shot: the she-donkey turns her head toward Balaam and opens her mouth to speak, eyebrows raised, looking hurt and reasonable. Balaam, standing beside her with his stick lowered, looks back at her. A few little sparkles in the air hint at the miracle. Warm afternoon light.

Balaam stands with hands on his hips arguing with his donkey face to face, as if it were completely normal, mouth wide open mid-rant, pointing at her. The donkey looks back patiently with half-closed eyes. A passing bird on the wall looks astonished. Comic medium shot, bright light.

The she-donkey speaks gently, nuzzling toward Balaam with soft, loyal eyes. Balaam scratches his long grey beard thoughtfully, his stick hanging loose at his side, his anger fading into a slightly embarrassed look as he remembers their many years together. Warm late-afternoon light on the narrow rocky path, close two-shot of the pair.

Balaam's eyes are suddenly opened: he sees the tall Angel of soft white light standing calmly on the path with a raised open hand. Balaam drops his stick and his hat tumbles off, his mouth an 'oh', and he bows down sheepishly. The she-donkey stands beside him, looking a little smug. Glowing light from the Angel, medium-wide shot.

On a high mountaintop with stone altars, Balaam stands beside King Balak and looks down at the camp of Israel in the valley: neat rows of tents arranged around the Mishkan, colorful tribal flags. Balaam opens his mouth and his arms spread wide in an unexpected blessing, a warm golden light over the camp. Balak looks shocked. Wide sweeping view at sunset.

King Balak stamps his feet in a comic tantrum, crown tilting, face red, arms waving. Balaam shrugs helplessly. To the side, the she-donkey stands calmly, flapping her long ears and smiling slightly at the viewer. Mountaintop at golden hour, comic medium-wide shot.

Peaceful closing scene: on the path home at dusk, Balaam walks beside his she-donkey instead of riding her, gently patting her neck, and the donkey leans her head against him. The road winds through quiet hills, first stars in the sky. Warm, reconciling mood, wide shot.
